A Hero's is derived from its\nEnglish Official name (`Vanessa` → `vanessa`) when the Hero is added, and stays\nthe same when that name is later corrected. A Guide's","originalFile":"# The Bazaar Guide Site (大巴扎攻略站)\n\nA small CMS where streamers (up主) and invited writers in the Chinese-speaking\ncommunity of the card game The Bazaar publish written guides, so players can\nfind a build for a given hero and patch without scrubbing through videos.\n\n## Language\n\n### People\n\n**Admin** (管理员):\nOne of the few top streamers who run the site. Reviews and publishes other\npeople's Guides and manages users.\n_Avoid_: owner, superuser\n\n**Editor** (编辑):\nAn invited guide writer (another up主 or an experienced player). Writes\nGuides but cannot publish them or manage users.\n_Avoid_: author (as a role name), contributor, writer\n\n**Reader** (读者):\nAnyone who plays the game and reads the public site. Has no account.\n_Avoid_: user, visitor, member\n\n**Author** (作者):\nThe Admin or Editor who wrote a Guide. Readers can browse all of an Author's\nPublished Guides on that Author's page.\n_Avoid_: owner, creator, up主 (not every Author is a streamer)\n\n**Submission ban** (禁止投稿):\nAn account state in which an Editor can still log in and work on Drafts but\ncannot Submit Guides or Revisions. Their Published Guides stay on the site.\n_Avoid_: suspension, block, mute\n\n**Deactivated** (已停用):\nAn account state in which the person cannot log in at all. Their Published\nGuides stay on the site.\n_Avoid_: deleted, disabled, banned\n\n**First-login setup** (首次登录设置):\nThe step a person with a temporary password must finish before using the\nconsole: they choose their own password and their Display name.\n_Avoid_: onboarding, activation, registration\n\n**Display name** (昵称):\nThe name an Author chooses to be shown under publicly. It is never their\nlogin username.\n_Avoid_: username, handle\n\n### Content\n\n**Guide** (攻略):\nA written strategy piece about one Hero on one Patch, typically built around\nscreenshots of a lineup or deck with an explanation of how it plays. Guides\nfor tournament mode are still Guides.\n_Avoid_: article, tutorial, post\n\n**Page** (页面):\nA standalone piece of site content written by an Admin, such as About (关于),\nthat appears in the public navigation.\n_Avoid_: static page\n\n**Tournament announcement** (锦标赛预告):\nAn Admin-written notice about an upcoming in-game Tournament.\n_Avoid_: event, news, post\n\n**Tournament recap** (锦标赛回顾):\nAn Admin-written account of a Tournament that has already happened. It is a\nseparate item from that Tournament's announcement.\n_Avoid_: event, report, result\n\n**Chinese text / English text** (中文版 / 英文版):\nThe two language versions of a Guide (or other content), each with its own\ntitle and body. Chinese is required. English is optional, and content without\nit does not appear on the English site.\n_Avoid_: translation, localization, body\n\n### The game\n\n**Game Term** (游戏术语):\nA named thing in The Bazaar that has an official Chinese name and an official\nEnglish name, stored as a pair. It is one of seven kinds: Hero, Item, Skill,\nEnchantment, Monster, Merchant, or Event.\n_Avoid_: keyword, tag, entity\n\n**Item** (物品):\nThe Game Term kind for the cards a player builds with.\n_Avoid_: card\n\n**Event** (事件):\nThe Game Term kind for an in-game event a player encounters during a run. The\nword means only this; it is never used for a Tournament.\n_Avoid_: using \"event\" for Tournaments or site activity\n\n**Hero** (英雄):\nThe Game Term for a playable character. Every Guide is about exactly one Hero.\n_Avoid_: character, class\n\n**Official name** (官方名称):\nThe name the game itself uses for a Game Term in a given language. The site\nonly ever shows Official names.\n_Avoid_: nickname (外号), alias, translation\n\n**Slug** (网址名):\nThe short web-address name of a Hero or a Guide. A Hero's is derived from its\nEnglish Official name (`Vanessa` → `vanessa`) and follows that name when it is\ncorrected. A Guide's is `<hero-slug>-<id>` (`vanessa-12`), given when the Guide\nis created; it never changes on its own (not with the title, the Hero or a\nRevision), only when an Admin edits it, so shared links keep working. No two\nHeroes, and no two Guides, share one.\n_Avoid_: URL name, permalink, handle\n\n**Patch** (版本):\nThe game version a Guide was written for, such as `6.7`. Picked by the\nwriter. It describes when the Guide was written and is not a verdict on\nwhether the Guide is out of date.\n_Avoid_: version (also used for edits to a Guide), season\n\n**Current Patch** (当前版本):\nThe Patch an Admin added most recently. Adding a Patch always makes it the\nCurrent Patch, even if its number is lower than an earlier one's.\n_Avoid_: latest version, live patch\n\n**Tournament** (锦标赛):\nAn experimental in-game mode in which many players (up to about 100) play one\ngame together until there is one champion. It is run by the game, not\norganized by players. It has its own section on the site.\n_Avoid_: event, competition, league, match\n\n### Workflow\n\n**Draft** (草稿):\nA Guide its writer has not finished yet. Only its writer and Admins can see it.\n_Avoid_: unpublished\n\n**Submitted** (待审核):\nA Guide its writer has marked finished, waiting for an Admin to review it.\n_Avoid_: pending, draft, ready\n\n**Return** (退回):\nAn Admin's decision that a Submitted Guide is not ready. It goes back to its\nwriter as a Draft, with the Admin's notes.\n_Avoid_: reject, decline\n\n**Review note** (审核意见):\nPart of a Return: a passage quoted from the Guide together with the Admin's\nadvice on how to fix it.\n_Avoid_: comment (comments stay on Bilibili), feedback\n\n**Publish** (发布):\nAn Admin's approval of a Submitted Guide, which makes it Published. Publishing\ndoes not by itself change the public site.\n_Avoid_: approve, go live\n\n**Unpublish** (撤下):\nAn Admin taking a Published Guide off the site without deleting it. The Guide\ngoes back to its Author as a Draft, optionally with Review notes.\n_Avoid_: hide, archive, take offline\n\n**Published** (已发布):\nA Guide an Admin has approved. It will appear on the public site after the\nnext Site build.\n_Avoid_: live, approved\n\n**Trash** (回收站):\nWhere deleted Guides go. Only Admins can see it, and they can restore a Guide\nfrom it or delete it for good. A Guide in the Trash is never on the site.\n_Avoid_: archive, recycle bin, deleted\n\n**Revision** (修订):\nA proposed change to a Published Guide. While it waits for review the\nPublished Guide stays on the site unchanged. Once published, it replaces the\nold content and the old content is not shown.\n_Avoid_: version, new version, edit\n\n**Site build** (更新网站):\nRegenerating the public site from everything that is Published, and putting it\nonline. This is the only step that changes what Readers see.\n_Avoid_: publish, deploy, export\n\n## Flagged ambiguities\n\n- \"Draft\" was being used for both an unfinished Guide and a finished one\n  awaiting review. Those are now **Draft** and **Submitted**.\n- \"Version\" can mean the game's Patch or an edit to a Guide. Use **Patch** for\n  the game and **Revision** for an edit.\n- \"Publish\" meant both an Admin's approval and regenerating the site. Approval\n  is **Publish**; regenerating is **Site build**. An Editor never publishes:\n  their button is Submit (提交审核).\n- \"Event\" is a Game Term kind (事件). Tournament items are announcements and\n  recaps, never \"events\".\n- \"Card\" and \"Item\" are the same thing. Use **Item**.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":103,"oldLines":8,"newStart":103,"newLines":8,"lines":[" "," **Slug** (网址名):"," The short web-address name of a Hero or a Guide. A Hero's is derived from its","-English Official name (`Vanessa` → `vanessa`) and follows that name when it is","-corrected. A Guide's is `<hero-slug>-<id>` (`vanessa-12`), given when the Guide","+English Official name (`Vanessa` → `vanessa`) when the Hero is added, and stays","+the same when that name is later corrected. A Guide's is `<hero-slug>-<id>` (`vanessa-12`), given when the Guide"," is created; it never changes on its own (not with the title, the Hero or a"," Revision), only when an Admin edits it, so shared links keep working. No two"," Heroes, and no two Guides, share one."]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a5a52c54-a3d5-4dc8-93c8-1b824c2ba442","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"4534cf31-03f9-4fcb-bb7d-99b9190b17cd","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"4534cf31-03f9-4fcb-bb7d-99b9190b17cd","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"parentUuid":"0781f476-1327-4ac4-8e8f-f7cb72c193fc","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"dd828c0c-ddab-41db-ab8b-4d344d6dd743","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_011iT74XyxZGxpaEQ6m9CT2e","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/game.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"f09d8228-ddfc-41a1-b61d-071cc3c48bd0","timestamp":"2026-10-17T17:37:20.035Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/game.py","oldString":"    \"\"\"Change a Hero's Official names; its slug follows the English name.\n    Raises Refused as add_hero does.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en, hero_id)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE game_terms SET name_zh = ?, name_en = ?, slug = ?\"\n                 \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\", (name_zh, name_en, slug, hero_id))","newString":"    \"\"\"Change a Hero's Official names; its slug stays the one it was given\n    when added, so its page and its Guides' links never move. Raises Refused\n    if either name is missing.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE game_terms SET name_zh = ?, name_en = ?\"\n                 \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\", (name_zh, name_en, hero_id))","originalFile":"\"\"\"The game: Game Terms (so far only Heroes) and Patches.\n\nA Hero is a Game Term with an official Chinese and an official English name.\nIts URL slug is derived from the English Official name.\n\nA Patch is a game version such as `6.7`. Adding one makes it the Current\nPatch, so the Current Patch is simply the Patch added most recently.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Hero or Patch change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Patch:\n    id: int\n    name: str\n    is_current: bool\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Hero:\n    id: int\n    name_zh: str\n    name_en: str\n    slug: str\n\n\ndef _hero_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Hero:\n    return Hero(id=row[\"id\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"], name_en=row[\"name_en\"],\n                slug=row[\"slug\"])\n\n\ndef slugify(name_en: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`Vanessa` -> `vanessa`, `Black Knight` -> `black-knight`.\"\"\"\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", name_en.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _checked_names_and_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name_zh: str,\n                            name_en: str, hero_id: int | None = None\n                            ) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed, and the slug they give. Raises Refused if\n    either name is missing or another Hero already has that slug.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = name_zh.strip(), name_en.strip()\n    if not name_zh:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方中文名。\")\n    if not name_en:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方英文名。\")\n    slug = slugify(name_en)\n    if not slug:\n        raise Refused(\"官方英文名需要包含字母或数字，用来生成网址名。\")\n    clash = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT * FROM game_terms\"\n        \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND slug = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n        (slug, hero_id)).fetchone()\n    if clash:\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被英雄\"\n                      f\" {clash['name_zh']}（{clash['name_en']}）使用。\")\n    return name_zh, name_en, slug\n\n\ndef add_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, name_zh: str, name_en: str) -> Hero:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if either Official name is missing or the slug is taken.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO game_terms (kind, name_zh, name_en, slug)\"\n        \" VALUES ('hero', ?, ?, ?)\", (name_zh, name_en, slug))\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _hero_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int) -> Hero | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\",\n                       (hero_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _hero_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef edit_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int, *, name_zh: str,\n              name_en: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Change a Hero's Official names; its slug follows the English name.\n    Raises Refused as add_hero does.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en, hero_id)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE game_terms SET name_zh = ?, name_en = ?, slug = ?\"\n                 \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\", (name_zh, name_en, slug, hero_id))\n\n\ndef heroes(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Hero]:\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero'\"\n                        \" ORDER BY name_en COLLATE NOCASE\").fetchall()\n    return [_hero_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef add_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> Patch:\n    \"\"\"Add a Patch, which becomes the Current Patch.\n    Raises Refused if the name is blank or the Patch already exists.\"\"\"\n    name = name.strip()\n    if not name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写版本号，例如 6.7。\")\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO patches (name) VALUES (?)\", (name,))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(f\"版本 {name} 已存在。\") from None\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=True)\n\n\ndef patches(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Patch]:\n    \"\"\"Every Patch, newest first; the first is the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches ORDER BY id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=(i == 0))\n            for i, row in enumerate(rows)]\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":90,"oldLines":11,"newStart":90,"newLines":12,"lines":[" "," def edit_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int, *, name_zh: str,","               name_en: str) -> None:","-    \"\"\"Change a Hero's Official names; its slug follows the English name.","-    Raises Refused as add_hero does.\"\"\"","-    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en, hero_id)","-    conn.execute(\"UPDATE game_terms SET name_zh = ?, name_en = ?, slug = ?\"","-                 \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\", (name_zh, name_en, slug, hero_id))","+    \"\"\"Change a Hero's Official names; its slug stays the one it was given","+    when added, so its page and its Guides' links never move. Raises Refused","+    if either name is missing.\"\"\"","+    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)","+    conn.execute(\"UPDATE game_terms SET name_zh = ?, name_en = ?\"","+                 \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\", (name_zh, name_en, hero_id))"," "," "," def heroes(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Hero]:"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"0781f476-1327-4ac4-8e8f-f7cb72c193fc","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"4534cf31-03f9-4fcb-bb7d-99b9190b17cd","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"4534cf31-03f9-4fcb-bb7d-99b9190b17cd","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"parentUuid":"6c6c9539-94fe-480b-b176-670e27e99790","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"dd828c0c-ddab-41db-ab8b-4d344d6dd743","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013dS4U5fY5W2XyNKqMeMDCL","type":"tool_result","content":"The file /Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/game.py has been updated successfully."}]},"uuid":"add31675-be21-423f-9110-9d74a0cf8a76","timestamp":"2026-10-17T17:37:25.244Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/game.py","oldString":"def _checked_names_and_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name_zh: str,\n                            name_en: str, hero_id: int | None = None\n                            ) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed, and the slug they give. Raises Refused if\n    either name is missing or another Hero already has that slug.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = name_zh.strip(), name_en.strip()\n    if not name_zh:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方中文名。\")\n    if not name_en:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方英文名。\")\n    slug = slugify(name_en)\n    if not slug:\n        raise Refused(\"官方英文名需要包含字母或数字，用来生成网址名。\")\n    clash = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT * FROM game_terms\"\n        \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND slug = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n        (slug, hero_id)).fetchone()","newString":"def _checked_names(name_zh: str, name_en: str) -> tuple[str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed. Raises Refused if either is missing.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = name_zh.strip(), name_en.strip()\n    if not name_zh:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方中文名。\")\n    if not name_en:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方英文名。\")\n    return name_zh, name_en\n\n\ndef _checked_names_and_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name_zh: str,\n                            name_en: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed, and the slug they give. Raises Refused if\n    either name is missing or another Hero already has that slug.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n    slug = slugify(name_en)\n    if not slug:\n        raise Refused(\"官方英文名需要包含字母或数字，用来生成网址名。\")\n    clash = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND slug = ?\",\n        (slug,)).fetchone()","originalFile":"\"\"\"The game: Game Terms (so far only Heroes) and Patches.\n\nA Hero is a Game Term with an official Chinese and an official English name.\nIts URL slug is derived from the English Official name.\n\nA Patch is a game version such as `6.7`. Adding one makes it the Current\nPatch, so the Current Patch is simply the Patch added most recently.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Hero or Patch change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Patch:\n    id: int\n    name: str\n    is_current: bool\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Hero:\n    id: int\n    name_zh: str\n    name_en: str\n    slug: str\n\n\ndef _hero_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Hero:\n    return Hero(id=row[\"id\"], name_zh=row[\"name_zh\"], name_en=row[\"name_en\"],\n                slug=row[\"slug\"])\n\n\ndef slugify(name_en: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`Vanessa` -> `vanessa`, `Black Knight` -> `black-knight`.\"\"\"\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", name_en.lower()).strip(\"-\")\n\n\ndef _checked_names_and_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name_zh: str,\n                            name_en: str, hero_id: int | None = None\n                            ) -> tuple[str, str, str]:\n    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed, and the slug they give. Raises Refused if\n    either name is missing or another Hero already has that slug.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = name_zh.strip(), name_en.strip()\n    if not name_zh:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方中文名。\")\n    if not name_en:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写官方英文名。\")\n    slug = slugify(name_en)\n    if not slug:\n        raise Refused(\"官方英文名需要包含字母或数字，用来生成网址名。\")\n    clash = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT * FROM game_terms\"\n        \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND slug = ? AND id IS NOT ?\",\n        (slug, hero_id)).fetchone()\n    if clash:\n        raise Refused(f\"网址名 {slug} 已被英雄\"\n                      f\" {clash['name_zh']}（{clash['name_en']}）使用。\")\n    return name_zh, name_en, slug\n\n\ndef add_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, name_zh: str, name_en: str) -> Hero:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if either Official name is missing or the slug is taken.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en, slug = _checked_names_and_slug(conn, name_zh, name_en)\n    cur = conn.execute(\n        \"INSERT INTO game_terms (kind, name_zh, name_en, slug)\"\n        \" VALUES ('hero', ?, ?, ?)\", (name_zh, name_en, slug))\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _hero_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int) -> Hero | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\",\n                       (hero_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _hero_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef edit_hero(conn: sqlite3.Connection, hero_id: int, *, name_zh: str,\n              name_en: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Change a Hero's Official names; its slug stays the one it was given\n    when added, so its page and its Guides' links never move. Raises Refused\n    if either name is missing.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE game_terms SET name_zh = ?, name_en = ?\"\n                 \" WHERE kind = 'hero' AND id = ?\", (name_zh, name_en, hero_id))\n\n\ndef heroes(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Hero]:\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM game_terms WHERE kind = 'hero'\"\n                        \" ORDER BY name_en COLLATE NOCASE\").fetchall()\n    return [_hero_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef add_patch(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name: str) -> Patch:\n    \"\"\"Add a Patch, which becomes the Current Patch.\n    Raises Refused if the name is blank or the Patch already exists.\"\"\"\n    name = name.strip()\n    if not name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写版本号，例如 6.7。\")\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO patches (name) VALUES (?)\", (name,))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(f\"版本 {name} 已存在。\") from None\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches WHERE id = ?\",\n                       (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=True)\n\n\ndef patches(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Patch]:\n    \"\"\"Every Patch, newest first; the first is the Current Patch.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM patches ORDER BY id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [Patch(id=row[\"id\"], name=row[\"name\"], is_current=(i == 0))\n            for i, row in enumerate(rows)]\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":48,"oldLines":23,"newStart":48,"newLines":27,"lines":["     return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", name_en.lower()).strip(\"-\")"," "," ","-def _checked_names_and_slug(conn: sqlite3.Connection, name_zh: str,","-                            name_en: str, hero_id: int | None = None","-                            ) -> tuple[str, str, str]:","-    \"\"\"Both Official names, trimmed, and the slug they give. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"0fdd893e-276d-4e78-924e-eb62d784ec0d","timestamp":"2026-10-17T17:42:48.707Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/CONTEXT.md","oldString":"The Game Term for a playable character. Every Guide is about exactly one Hero.\nNo two Heroes share an English Official name (ignoring case).\n_Avoid_: character, class","originalFile":"# The Bazaar Guide Site (大巴扎攻略站)\n\nA small CMS where streamers (up主) and invited writers in the Chinese-speaking\ncommunity of the card game The Bazaar publish written guides, so players can\nfind a build for a given hero and patch without scrubbing through videos.\n\n## Language\n\n### People\n\n**Admin** (管理员):\nOne of the few top streamers who run the site. Reviews and publishes other\npeople's Guides and manages users.\n_Avoid_: owner, superuser\n\n**Editor** (编辑):\nAn invited guide writer (another up主 or an experienced player). Writes\nGuides but cannot publish them or manage users.\n_Avoid_: author (as a role name), contributor, writer\n\n**Reader** (读者):\nAnyone who plays the game and reads the public site. Has no account.\n_Avoid_: user, visitor, member\n\n**Author** (作者):\nThe Admin or Editor who wrote a Guide. Readers can browse all of an Author's\nPublished Guides on that Author's page.\n_Avoid_: owner, creator, up主 (not every Author is a streamer)\n\n**Submission ban** (禁止投稿):\nAn account state in which an Editor can still log in and work on Drafts but\ncannot Submit Guides or Revisions. Their Published Guides stay on the site.\n_Avoid_: suspension, block, mute\n\n**Deactivated** (已停用):\nAn account state in which the person cannot log in at all. Their Published\nGuides stay on the site.\n_Avoid_: deleted, disabled, banned\n\n**First-login setup** (首次登录设置):\nThe step a person with a temporary password must finish before using the\nconsole: they choose their own password and their Display name.\n_Avoid_: onboarding, activation, registration\n\n**Display name** (昵称):\nThe name an Author chooses to be shown under publicly. It is never their\nlogin username.\n_Avoid_: username, handle\n\n### Content\n\n**Guide** (攻略):\nA written strategy piece about one Hero on one Patch, typically built around\nscreenshots of a lineup or deck with an explanation of how it plays. Guides\nfor tournament mode are still Guides.\n_Avoid_: article, tutorial, post\n\n**Page** (页面):\nA standalone piece of site content written by an Admin, such as About (关于),\nthat appears in the public navigation.\n_Avoid_: static page\n\n**Tournament announcement** (锦标赛预告):\nAn Admin-written notice about an upcoming in-game Tournament.\n_Avoid_: event, news, post\n\n**Tournament recap** (锦标赛回顾):\nAn Admin-written account of a Tournament that has already happened. It is a\nseparate item from that Tournament's announcement.\n_Avoid_: event, report, result\n\n**Chinese text / English text** (中文版 / 英文版):\nThe two language versions of a Guide (or other content), each with its own\ntitle and body. Chinese is required. English is optional, and content without\nit does not appear on the English site.\n_Avoid_: translation, localization, body\n\n### The game\n\n**Game Term** (游戏术语):\nA named thing in The Bazaar that has an official Chinese name and an official\nEnglish name, stored as a pair. It is one of seven kinds: Hero, Item, Skill,\nEnchantment, Monster, Merchant, or Event.\n_Avoid_: keyword, tag, entity\n\n**Item** (物品):\nThe Game Term kind for the cards a player builds with.\n_Avoid_: card\n\n**Event** (事件):\nThe Game Term kind for an in-game event a player encounters during a run. The\nword means only this; it is never used for a Tournament.\n_Avoid_: using \"event\" for Tournaments or site activity\n\n**Hero** (英雄):\nThe Game Term for a playable character. Every Guide is about exactly one Hero.\n_Avoid_: character, class\n\n**Official name** (官方名称):\nThe name the game itself uses for a Game Term in a given language. The site\nonly ever shows Official names.\n_Avoid_: nickname (外号), alias, translation\n\n**Slug** (网址名):\nThe short web-address name of a Hero or a Guide. A Hero's is derived from its\nEnglish Official name (`Vanessa` → `vanessa`) when the Hero is added, and stays\nthe same when that name is later corrected. A Guide's is `<hero-slug>-<id>` (`vanessa-12`), given when the Guide\nis created; it never changes on its own (not with the title, the Hero or a\nRevision), only when an Admin edits it, so shared links keep working. No two\nHeroes, and no two Guides, share one.\n_Avoid_: URL name, permalink, handle\n\n**Patch** (版本):\nThe game version a Guide was written for, such as `6.7`. Picked by the\nwriter. It describes when the Guide was written and is not a verdict on\nwhether the Guide is out of date.\n_Avoid_: version (also used for edits to a Guide), season\n\n**Current Patch** (当前版本):\nThe Patch an Admin added most recently. Adding a Patch always makes it the\nCurrent Patch, even if its number is lower than an earlier one's.\n_Avoid_: latest version, live patch\n\n**Tournament** (锦标赛):\nAn experimental in-game mode in which many players (up to about 100) play one\ngame together until there is one champion. It is run by the game, not\norganized by players. It has its own section on the site.\n_Avoid_: event, competition, league, match\n\n### Workflow\n\n**Draft** (草稿):\nA Guide its writer has not finished yet. Only its writer and Admins can see it.\n_Avoid_: unpublished\n\n**Submitted** (待审核):\nA Guide its writer has marked finished, waiting for an Admin to review it.\n_Avoid_: pending, draft, ready\n\n**Return** (退回):\nAn Admin's decision that a Submitted Guide is not ready. It goes back to its\nwriter as a Draft, with the Admin's notes.\n_Avoid_: reject, decline\n\n**Review note** (审核意见):\nPart of a Return: a passage quoted from the Guide together with the Admin's\nadvice on how to fix it.\n_Avoid_: comment (comments stay on Bilibili), feedback\n\n**Publish** (发布):\nAn Admin's approval of a Submitted Guide, which makes it Published. Publishing\ndoes not by itself change the public site.\n_Avoid_: approve, go live\n\n**Unpublish** (撤下):\nAn Admin taking a Published Guide off the site without deleting it. The Guide\ngoes back to its Author as a Draft, optionally with Review notes.\n_Avoid_: hide, archive, take offline\n\n**Published** (已发布):\nA Guide an Admin has approved. It will appear on the public site after the\nnext Site build.\n_Avoid_: live, approved\n\n**Trash** (回收站):\nWhere deleted Guides go. Only Admins can see it, and they can restore a Guide\nfrom it or delete it for good. A Guide in the Trash is never on the site.\n_Avoid_: archive, recycle bin, deleted\n\n**Revision** (修订):\nA proposed change to a Published Guide. While it waits for review the\nPublished Guide stays on the site unchanged. Once published, it replaces the\nold content and the old content is not shown.\n_Avoid_: version, new version, edit\n\n**Site build** (更新网站):\nRegenerating the public site from everything that is Published, and putting it\nonline. This is the only step that changes what Readers see.\n_Avoid_: publish, deploy, export\n\n## Flagged ambiguities\n\n- \"Draft\" was being used for both an unfinished Guide and a finished one\n  awaiting review. Those are now **Draft** and **Submitted**.\n- \"Version\" can mean the game's Patch or an edit to a Guide. Use **Patch** for\n  the game and **Revision** for an edit.\n- \"Publish\" meant both an Admin's approval and regenerating the site. Approval\n  is **Publish**; regenerating is **Site build**. An Editor never publishes:\n  their button is Submit (提交审核).\n- \"Event\" is a Game Term kind (事件). Tournament items are announcements and\n  recaps, never \"events\".\n- \"Card\" and \"Item\" are the same thing. Use **Item**.\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":94,"oldLines":6,"newStart":94,"newLines":7,"lines":[" "," **Hero** (英雄):"," The Game Term for a playable character. Every Guide is about exactly one Hero.","+No two Heroes share an English Official name (ignoring case)."," _Avoid_: character, class"," "," **Official name** (官方名称):"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"109d7dab-98d6-4920-a240-7572d2270ce4","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"4534cf31-03f9-4fcb-bb7d-99b9190b17cd","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"4534cf31-03f9-4fcb-bb7d-99b9190b17cd","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

AND id IS NOT ?\",\n        (name_en, hero_id)).fetchone()\n    if clash:\n        raise Refused(f\"官方英文名 {clash['name_en']} 已被英雄\"\n                      f\" {clash['name_zh']} 使用。\")\n\n\ndef _checked_names_and_slug(''')\ns = s.replace('''    either name is missing or another Hero already has that slug.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n    slug''', '''    either name is missing or another Hero already has that English name or\n    slug.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, name_en)\n    slug''')\ns = s.replace('''    \"\"\"Raises Refused if either Official name is missing or the slug is taken.\"\"\"''',\n '''    \"\"\"Raises Refused if either Official name is missing or the English name\n    or slug is taken.\"\"\"''')\ns = s.replace('''    when added, so its page and its Guides' links never move. Raises Refused\n    if either name is missing.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n''', '''    when added, so its page and its Guides' links never move. Raises Refused\n    if either name is missing or another Hero has that English name.\"\"\"\n    name_zh, name_en = _checked_names(name_zh, name_en)\n    _refuse_a_taken_english_name(conn, name_en, hero_id)\n''')\np.write_text(s)\nEOF\ngit diff app/game.py | grep -c \"_refuse_a_taken_english_name\"","description":"Add the duplicate English name check to add and edit"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Cc8H3f2XqDGjFw7tCNqSWe","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/CONTEXT.md","old_string":"The Game Term for a playable character. Every Guide is about exactly one Hero.\nNo two Heroes share an English Official name (ignoring case).\n_Avoid_: character, class"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_013s5gVqovQuk2yMH1EZcGra","name":"Edit","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/tests/test_t02_heroes_patches.py","old_string":"def test_editing_a_hero_that_does_not_exist_is_not_found(client_as):","new_string":"def test_an_edit_that_takes_another_heros_english_name_is_refused(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"杜利\", \"Dooley\")\n\n    clash = edit_hero(admin, \"Dooley\", name_zh=\"杜利\", name_en=\"VANESSA\")\n    assert clash.status_code == 400\n    assert \"官方英文名 Vanessa 已被英雄 瓦妮莎 使用\" in clash.text\n    assert \"<td>杜利</td><td>Dooley</td>\" in admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n\n\ndef test_a_new_hero_cannot_take_a_corrected_heros_english_name(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮沙\", \"Vanesa\")\n    edit_hero(admin, \"Vanesa\", name_zh=\"瓦妮莎\", name_en=\"Vanessa\")\n\n    response = add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"官方英文名 Vanessa 已被英雄 瓦妮莎 使用\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_editing_a_hero_that_does_not_exist_is_not_found(client_as):"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017JQut8bqmKggYoQGFD3NhZ","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"sed -n 1,30p tests/test_t02_heroes_patches.py | grep -n -A6 \"def add_hero\\|def submit\"; sed -n 49,70p tests/test_t02_heroes_patches.py","description":"Check the add_hero test helper's return value"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}]}}

It stays /vanesa, and the page keeps telling them it will update.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/game.py\",\n    \"line\": 83,\n    \"summary\": \"Now that the slug stays put after an English-name fix, a new Hero can be blocked by an old slug whose name no Hero has any more. Guides already handle this with a `-n` suffix in guides.py:199-203.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/game.py\",\n    \"line\": 83,\n    \"summary\": \"In add, the slug-clash check runs before the new English-name check, so the usual duplicate gets the slug message instead of the new '官方英文名 … 已被英雄 … 使用' message.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Hero 'Vanessa' exists with its original slug. Users see different messages for one rule, and no test covers the add-path duplicate when the slug is unchanged.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/db.py\",\n    \"line\": 41,\n    \"summary\": \"The new rule 'no two Heroes share an English Official name, ignoring case' lives only in an application-level SELECT-then-write. csrf_token\n\n\ndef submit(c: TestClient, form_page: str, action: str, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Fill in the form on `form_page` the way a browser does, token included.\"\"\"\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(form_page).text)\n    return c.post(action, data={\"csrf_token\": token, **fields},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef add_hero(c: TestClient, name_zh: str, name_en: str):\n    return submit(c, \"/admin/heroes\", \"/admin/heroes\",\n                  name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n\n\ndef test_admin_adds_a_hero_and_sees_it_listed_with_its_slug(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/heroes\"\n\n    page = admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\")\n    assert page.status_code == 200\n    assert \"瓦妮莎\" in page.text and \"Vanessa\" in page.text\n    assert \"vanessa\" in page.text\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"name_zh, name_en, message\", [\n    (\"\", \"Vanessa\", \"请填写官方中文名\"),\n    (\"瓦妮莎\", \"   \", \"请填写官方英文名\"),\n])\ndef test_a_hero_missing_either_official_name_is_refused(client_as, name_zh,\n                                                        name_en, message):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    response = add_hero(admin, name_zh, name_en)\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert message in response.text\n    assert \"还没有英雄\" in admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n\n\ndef test_a_two_word_english_name_gives_a_hyphenated_slug(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"黑骑士\", \"Black  Knight\")\n    assert \"<code>black-knight</code>\" in admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n\n\ndef test_a_hero_whose_slug_is_already_taken_is_refused(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n\n    response = add_hero(admin, \"另一个瓦妮莎\", \"vanessa \")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"网址名 vanessa 已被英雄 瓦妮莎（Vanessa）使用\" in response.text\n    assert \"另一个瓦妮莎\" not in admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n\n\ndef test_an_english_name_with_no_letters_or_digits_is_refused(client_as):\n    response = add_hero(client_as(\"admin\"), \"问号\", \"???\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    assert \"英文名需要包含字母或数字\" in response.text\n\n\ndef edit_link(c: TestClient, listed_en: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The edit page linked from the Hero list row showing `listed_en`.\"\"\"\n    row = next(r for r in c.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text.split(\"<tr>\")\n               if f\"<td>{listed_en}</td>\" in r)\n    match = re.search(r'href=\"(/admin/heroes/\\d+/edit)\"', row)\n    assert match, f\"no edit link for {listed_en}\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef edit_hero(c: TestClient, listed_en: str, **fields):\n    page = edit_link(c, listed_en)\n    return submit(c, page, page.removesuffix(\"/edit\"), **fields)\n\n\ndef test_admin_corrects_a_heros_official_names_and_the_slug_stays(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮沙\", \"Vanesa\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"杜利\", \"Dooley\")\n\n    response = edit_hero(admin, \"Vanesa\", name_zh=\"瓦妮莎\", name_en=\"Vanessa\")\n    assert test_an_edit_that_takes_another_heros_english_name_is_refused(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"杜利\", \"Dooley\")\n\n    clash = edit_hero(admin, \"Dooley\", name_zh=\"杜利\", name_en=\"VANESSA\")\n    assert clash.status_code == 400\n    assert \"官方英文名 Vanessa 已被英雄 瓦妮莎 使用\" in clash.text\n    assert \"<td>杜利</td><td>Dooley</td>\" in admin.get(\"/admin/heroes\").text\n\n\ndef test_a_new_hero_cannot_take_a_corrected_heros_english_name(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮沙\", \"Vanesa\")\n    edit_hero(admin, \"Vanesa\", name_zh=\"瓦妮莎\", name_en=\"Vanessa\")\n\n    response = add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    assert response.status_code == client_as(\"admin\").get(\"/admin/heroes/999/edit\").status_code == 404\n\n\ndef add_patch(c: TestClient, name: str):\n    return submit(c, \"/admin/patches\", \"/admin/patches\", name=name)\n\n\ndef test_the_newest_patch_added_becomes_the_current_patch(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    assert add_patch(admin, \"6.6\").headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/patches\"\n    assert {"parentUuid":"b18890f2-0e81-48f3-b835-195a1ee7b151","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8E8LsQvoQdow8LoEmSo","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01EKC8UzPCtAqGL3kJeCRGyu","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"f=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/4534cf31-03f9-4fcb-bb7d-99b9190b17cd/scratchpad/issue15-review.md\ncat > \"$f\" <<'EOF'\n## `/code-review` findings (medium) and how each was resolved\n\nScope: this branch's changes for #15. The edit keeps a Hero's Slug, and no two Heroes share an English Official name (checked on add and on edit).\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---------|------------|\n| 1 | `templates/admin/hero_edit.html` still said the slug follows the English Official name (\"网址名会跟随官方英文名自动更新\"). | **Fixed.** It now says \"网址名在添加英雄时生成，之后修改名称也不会改变。\" |\n| 2 | With the Slug fixed, an old misspelled Slug can block a later real Hero. Add `Vanesa` (slug `vanesa`) and correct it to `Vanessa`. Adding a real Hero named `Vanesa` is then refused, and there's no way past it, because Hero Slugs can't be edited and get no `-n` suffix. | **Deferred.** It needs a decision between a `-n` suffix like Guides and letting Admins edit a Hero's Slug. It only happens when a misspelling matches another real Hero's name. The refusal message names the Hero holding the Slug. |\n| 3 | In add, the Slug check ran before the English-name check, so the same duplicate got a different message on add than on edit. | **Fixed.** The English-name check runs first on both paths. `test_a_hero_whose_slug_is_already_taken_is_refused` now uses `Vanessa!` (a different name that gives the same Slug). New test: `test_a_new_hero_with_another_heros_english_name_is_refused`. |\n| 4 | The English-name rule is checked in application code only, with no `UNIQUE` index on `(kind, lower(name_en))`. | **Not changed.** The console is local and used by a single Admin, so a race is very unlikely. An index would also stop startup on any local database that already has duplicates. SQLite's `lower()` is ASCII-only too (see 5). |\n| 5 | SQLite's `lower()` folds only ASCII, so `Éclair` and `ÉCLAIR` weren't caught. | **Fixed.** The comparison now uses Python's `str.casefold()`. New test: `test_english_names_clash_ignoring_non_ascii_case_too`. |\n| 6 | The `app/game.py` module docstring didn't say the Slug is set only once. | **Fixed.** It now says the Slug is derived once, when the Hero is added, and never changes after that. |\n| 7 | The help text in `templates/admin/heroes.html` didn't say the Slug is fixed after creation. | **Fixed.** It now says \"网址名在添加时由英文名生成，之后不再改变。\" |\n| 8 | `test_editing_only_the_chinese_name_keeps_the_heros_own_slug` is now redundant. The add-path duplicate message had no test. | **Partly fixed.** The add-path test was added (see 3). Use the user's domain language from `GLOSSARY.md`.\n\n### Summary\n\nPick the smallest view that makes the key point clear.\n\n- Show logic or an algorithm as pseudocode:\n\n```text\non(save)\n  if content is unchanged\n    return cached result\n  write new content\n  return fresh result\n```\n\n- Show runtime control flow as a call tree:\n\n```text\nsubmitForm\n  createSession\n    persistPrompt\n    launchAgent\n  navigateToSession\n```\n\n- Show UI structure as a component tree, including state and module boundaries that matter:\n\n```text\n<SessionPage> (apps/example/src/routes/session.tsx)\n  useSessionEvents()\n  <SessionToolbar>\n    <RunSkillButton> (packages/ui)\n```\n\n- Show file responsibility or a broad refactor as a shallow file tree:\n\n```text\nsrc/\n├── commands/       # parses user actions\n├── sessions/       # owns session state\n└── transport/      # sends API requests\n```\n\n- Show component interaction, control flow, or data flow with Mermaid:\n\n```mermaid\nsequenceDiagram\n    participant User\n    participant UI\n    participant Daemon\n    User->>UI: choose command\n    UI->>Daemon: send expanded prompt\n    Daemon-->>UI: stream result\n```\n\n- Use `diff` when the point is what changes and the surrounding shape already exists. Match the diff shape to the topic.\n\nFor a component change:\n\n```diff\n <SessionPage>\n   useSessionEvents()\n   <SessionToolbar>\n+    <RunSkillButton />\n   <SessionTimeline>\n+    <SkillResultCard />\n```\n\nFor a file-layout change:\n\n```diff\n src/\n ├── commands/\n+│   └── show-me.ts       # expands the slash command\n ├── sessions/\n-└── transport.ts\n+└── transport/\n+    ├── client.ts\n+    └── stream.ts\n```\n\nFor a call-tree or call-stack change:\n\n```diff\n submitForm\n   createSession\n     persistPrompt\n+    expandSkillMention\n     launchAgent\n-  navigateToSession\n+  navigateToSession\n+    subscribeToEvents\n```\n\nFor a state or control-flow change:\n\n```diff\n on(save)\n-  write content\n+  if content is unchanged\n+    return cached result\n+  write new content\n+  invalidate cache\n```\n\n- Show the whole block when most of it is new, when omitted context would hide ownership or order, or when the user needs a copyable target shape:\n\n```ts\nfunction expandSkill(command: string): string {\n  const skillName = command.slice(1);\n  return `use the ${skillName} skill`;\n}\n```\n\n#### Guidance\n\nPlace each visual next to the short text it supports. Keep only the calls, files, props, states, and boundaries needed to answer the user's current question or the options to resolve the current discussion point.\n\nYou may use one of these, you may use several, it is unlikely you will use all of them. Use your judgement and don't overwhelm the user.\n\n### Evidence\n\nConcrete evidence that the change works. Show a before and after.\n\nScreenshots are S-tier - when the environment is set up for it and the change is visual.\n\nExecution-based evidence is A-tier. Test results, console output. Show the exact test that now fails and passes, using pseudocode.\n\n### Merge Danger\n\nDescribe whether it's a one-way or two-way door. You can walk back through two-way doors, but not one-way doors. A PR that is cheap to roll back is lower risk. Changes that involve destructive actions or hard-to-reverse decisions are one-way doors.\n\nThe blast radius is the potential impact or scope of the changes introduced by this PR. Consider all possibilities. Examples are layout shift, breakages for consumers, mobile responsiveness, etc.\n"}]}}

The Site build (T04) hasn't shipped, so no public Hero URLs exist yet.\n\n**Blast Radius:** small\n\nOnly the Hero admin pages. An edit that used to succeed now gets refused if it gives a Hero another Hero's English name. Otherwise, after `Vanesa` is corrected to `Vanessa`, a new `Vanessa` could still be added, because its Slug (`vanessa`) wouldn't clash with the corrected Hero's (`vanesa`). `CONTEXT.md` states the rule under **Hero**. Both now get the English-name message.\n  - The case check missed non-ASCII letters. That's your call.\n- **Not changed:** the reviewer suggested a database `UNIQUE` index for the name rule. I left it out because the console has one local Admin.
